quiz.question_id: Manakah case yang valid untuk membuat timeout 500ms di dalam `select`?
quiz.question_en: Which case is valid for creating a 500ms timeout inside a `select`?
options_en: `case time.After(500 * time.Millisecond):`
`case <-time.After(500 * time.Millisecond):`
`default <-time.After(500 * time.Millisecond):`
`case time.Sleep(500 * time.Millisecond):`

quiz.question_id: Apa yang terjadi jika dua case dalam `select` siap pada saat yang sama?
quiz.question_en: What happens if two cases in a `select` are ready at the same time?
options_id: Go memilih salah satu case yang siap secara acak
options_en: The first case is always chosen
All cases are executed in order
Go chooses one of the ready cases at random
The program panics because the outcome is ambiguous

quiz.question_id: Jika tidak ada case yang siap dan `select` tidak memiliki `default`, apa yang terjadi?
quiz.question_en: If no case is ready and the `select` has no `default`, what happens?
options_id: `select` akan memblokir sampai ada operasi channel yang siap
options_en: The `select` blocks until a channel operation becomes ready
The `select` automatically skips the block
The last case runs as a fallback
The runtime closes all channels

quiz.question_en: What is the role of `default` in a `select`?
options_id: Membuat semua case lain memiliki prioritas lebih rendah
Memaksa receive dari semua channel sekaligus
Membuat `select` menjadi non-blocking jika tidak ada channel yang siap
options_en: It makes all other cases lower priority
It forces receives from all channels at once
It closes channels that are not ready
It makes the `select` non-blocking when no channel is ready

quiz.question_id: Apa keuntungan utama `select` dibanding receive tunggal dari satu channel pada lesson ini?
quiz.question_en: What is the main advantage of `select` over a single receive from one channel in this lesson?
options_id: Bisa menunggu beberapa operasi channel sekaligus
options_en: It can wait on multiple channel operations at once
It converts all channels into buffered ones
It runs all cases in parallel
It removes the need for goroutines

quiz.question_id: Dalam pola done channel, apa arti `case <-done:`?
quiz.question_en: In the done-channel pattern, what does `case <-done:` mean?
options_id: Worker harus mengirim sinyal berhenti ke channel
Worker menerima sinyal pembatalan dan harus berhenti
Worker mengganti channel `done` dengan channel baru
Worker hanya boleh berhenti jika channel buffered
options_en: The worker must send a stop signal into the channel
The worker receives a cancellation signal and should stop
The worker replaces the `done` channel with a new one
The worker may only stop if the channel is buffered

quiz.question_id: Mengapa loop pada contoh multi-channel berjalan dua kali?
quiz.question_en: Why does the loop in the multi-channel example run twice?
options_id: Untuk memaksa `select` memilih `ch1` lalu `ch2` secara berurutan
Karena setiap `select` selalu harus dipanggil minimal dua kali
Untuk menerima dua pesan total, satu dari masing-masing goroutine, lewat dua eksekusi `select`
options_en: To force `select` to choose `ch1` and then `ch2` in order
Because every `select` must always be called at least twice
So the `default` branch gets a chance to run
To receive two total messages, one from each goroutine, across two `select` executions

quiz.question_id: Apa yang benar tentang `default` pada pola worker dengan done channel?
quiz.question_en: What is true about `default` in the worker pattern with a done channel?
options_id: `default` memastikan worker selalu berhenti setelah satu iterasi
`default` memungkinkan worker tetap melakukan pekerjaan saat belum ada sinyal selesai
options_en: `default` automatically closes the `done` channel
`default` ensures the worker always stops after one iteration
`default` allows the worker to keep doing work while no done signal has arrived
`default` makes the channel send-only
